verdict.rationale: A live public status page (status.cerebras.ai) was confirmed via probe, returning HTTP 200 and showing an 'operational' status, which supports founders checking service health before committing production traffic. However, there's no evidence in the pack of a visible incident history log or historical uptime records on that page, and community threads note some real-world reliability hiccups (rate-limit bursts, onboarding scaling issues) without connecting them to the status page. Missing for 10: documented incident history/timeline on the status page, uptime SLA data, and independent confirmation that past incidents are publicly logged.
